scope: 24 exact final Starter/upgraded curated-results captures visually inspected; static hosted96DPI, not high-DPI, physical trackpad or multi-monitor acceptance. Separate results and temporal scrolling evidence is in the release regression record.

reviews.scope: Six exact native captures independently inspected. No unintended overlap or clipping in fixed controls. Catalogue/detail panes intentionally scroll; the graph viewport clips off-screen nodes and abbreviates titles. Results Tools column uses ellipses. Failure guidance and no-QC-threshold wording are readable, and empty search clears content and disables result actions. No high-DPI, multi-monitor, physical-trackpad or temporal claim.

captures.reviewedFormat: PNG converted from BMP without changing dimensions or RGB pixels
captures.finding: Workflow names, availability, section labels and all action buttons are readable and separated. Longer requirement and notice text continues inside visible scroll panes; bottom-line clipping is viewport scrolling, not a fixed control overlap.

captures.reviewedFormat: PNG converted from BMP without changing dimensions or RGB pixels
captures.finding: Navigation, workflow actions, tool-option labels and connected-source buttons are readable without overlap. Node-title ellipses and the right edge of the partially visible DAG node occur within the explicitly scrollable canvas.

captures.reviewedFormat: PNG converted from BMP without changing dimensions or RGB pixels
captures.finding: Search, selected analysis, status, sample, started time, measured-result disclaimer and actions are readable. The long Tools cell is ellipsized and remaining metrics continue in the visible summary scroll pane.

captures.reviewedFormat: PNG converted from BMP without changing dimensions or RGB pixels
captures.finding: Missing-input diagnosis, missing scientific-evidence notice and next steps are readable. Action states are consistent with the shown failed preparation; no labels or buttons overlap.

captures.reviewedFormat: PNG converted from BMP without changing dimensions or RGB pixels
captures.finding: Scrolled guidance displays the missing path, restore-or-rerun advice and no-invented-threshold interpretation clearly. Wrapped lines stay inside the summary pane and footer/actions remain separate.

captures.reviewedFormat: PNG converted from BMP without changing dimensions or RGB pixels
captures.finding: Empty search shows no stale selected row or summary, gives the clear-search instruction, and disables both result actions. Fixed labels and buttons remain readable.

limits: Visual review is limited to these six retained hosted Windows captures at 96 DPI.
Intentional scroll-pane and DAG viewport clipping and list-cell ellipses are distinguished from fixed-control overlap.
This review does not establish high-DPI, multi-monitor, physical-trackpad or representative-PC acceptance.
Images alone do not establish functional behavior; native assertions remain in the separately retained updater and curated reports.
